title: 損害賠償請求事件　第13回口頭弁論期日進捗状況
title_en: Progress of the 13th oral argument hearing in the damages claim case
contents: 第1回口頭弁論期日が行われましたので、ご報告いたします。日時：202５年9月4日午後1時30分から午後１時40分場所：静岡地方裁判所201号法廷裁判官：  平山馨裁判官、川原田貴弘裁判官、溝口航平裁判官（民事2部合議C係）出席：原告代理人2名　原告２名　傍聴者８名　　被告被告代理人３名　被告２名　傍聴者２名一般傍聴者５名　【今後の予定】次回口頭弁論期日は2025年11月６日(木)午後１時３０分～【第13回弁論準備　期日の内容】１．書面提出被告告側は準備書面9を提出しました。被告の主張である新設予定の焼却炉は隣接区のため変更であるので環境アセスメントは不要という主張に対し、静岡県の一般的な条例対応はどのようになるのかを調査し書類を提出することになりました。終了後午後４時より沼津市民文化センターにて報告会、記者会見行いました。別件提訴の併合については検討中次回さらに書面を提出します。
contents_en: We are pleased to report that the first oral argument date has been held. Date and time: September 4, 2025, 1:30-1:40 PM Venue: Shizuoka District Court, Courtroom 201 Judges: Judge Kaoru Hirayama, Judge Takahiro Kawarada, Judge Kohei Mizoguchi (Civil Division 2, Collegial Section C) Attendance: 2 plaintiff attorneys 2 plaintiffs 8 observers 3 Defendants' attorneys 2 Defendants 2 Spectators 5 general spectators [Future plans] The next oral argument will be held on Thursday, November 6, 2025, from 1:30 p.m. [Contents of the 13th Oral Preparation Date] 1. Submission of documents The defendant has submitted Brief 9. In response to the defendant's claim that the proposed new incinerator is in an adjacent district and therefore a change, so an environmental assessment is not necessary, we decided to investigate how Shizuoka Prefecture's general ordinances would be handled and submit documents. After the event, a report session and press conference was held at the Numazu Civic Cultural Center from 4:00 p.m. We are currently considering the consolidation of separate lawsuits and will submit further documents next time.

title: 損害賠償請求事件　第12回口頭弁論期日進捗状況
title_en: Progress of the 12th oral argument hearing in the damages claim case
contents: 第12回口頭弁論期日が行われましたので、ご報告いたします。日時：202５年７月３日午後3時から午後４時３０分場所：静岡地方裁判所201号法廷裁判官：  平山馨裁判官、川原田貴弘裁判官、溝口航平裁判官（民事2部合議C係）出席：原告代理人2名（Web）　原告１名　傍聴者4名　被告被告代理人３名　原告5名一般傍聴者５名　【今後の予定】次回口頭弁論期日は2025年９月４日(木)午後１時３０分～【第1２回弁論準備　期日の内容】１．書面提出被告告側は準備書面５を提出しました。被告の主張である新設予定の焼却炉は隣接区のため変更であるので環境アセスメントは不要という主張に対し、裁判官よりその判断の基準をどこに置いているのか明確にするようにという指示があり、その証明のため証拠説明書と乙号証拠１０を提出しましたが、内容に根拠が乏しく明確でないという原告からの指摘によりさらに書面を提出することになりました。終了後午後５時３０分より清水町枯山水にて報告会を行い、原告他沼津市、清水町サポータの参加があり、２時間強の交流時間となりました。6月18日にこの件に併合予定で訴状をさらに提出ていることから裁判官より訴状訂正の申立を行い内容を明確にし併合ができるか確認すると言い渡されているので次回は併合に持っていけるよう書面を提出します。
contents_en: We are pleased to report that the 12th oral argument hearing has taken place. Date and time: July 3, 2025, 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM Venue: Shizuoka District Court, Courtroom 201 Judges: Judge Kaoru Hirayama, Judge Takahiro Kawarada, Judge Kohei Mizoguchi (Civil Division 2, Collegial Section C) Attendance: 2 plaintiff attorneys (Web) 1 plaintiff 4 observers Defendant: 3 attorneys, 5 plaintiffs: 5 general spectators [Future plans] The next oral argument will be held on Thursday, September 4, 2025, from 1:30 p.m. [Contents of the 12th Oral Preparation Date] 1. Submission of documents The defendant submitted Brief 5. In response to the defendant's claim that an environmental assessment was not necessary because the proposed new incinerator was in an adjacent district and therefore a change, the judge instructed the defendant to clarify the criteria for making that judgment.To prove this, the defendant submitted an Evidence Explanation Document and Exhibit B-10.However, the plaintiff pointed out that the contents of these documents lacked evidence and were not clear, so the defendant decided to submit further documents. After the meeting, a report session was held at Karesansui in Shimizu Town from 5:30 pm, with participation from the plaintiffs and supporters from Numazu City and Shimizu Town, resulting in just over two hours of social interaction. Since we have filed a further complaint on June 18th with the intention of consolidating this case, the judge has told us that we should file a motion to amend the complaint to clarify the contents and confirm whether consolidation is possible, so next time we will submit documents so that we can proceed with consolidation.

contents_en: We are pleased to report that the 11th oral argument date has been held. Date and time: May 15, 2025, 3:00 pm to 3:15 pm Venue: Shizuoka District Court, Courtroom 201 Judges: Judge Kaoru Hirayama, Judge Takahiro Kawarada, and Judge Kohei Mizoguchi (Civil Division 2, Deliberation Section C) Attendance: 2 plaintiff attorneys (WEB) 2 plaintiffs 4 observers 1 defendant, 2 defendant attorneys (WEB) 10 general spectators [Future plans] The next oral argument date is Thursday, July 3, 2025 at 4:30 p.m. [Contents of the 11th oral argument preparation date] 1. Submission of documents The defendants submitted Preparatory Brief 4, which is a rebuttal to the Plaintiffs' Preparatory Briefs 7 and 8. The defendants' argument that an environmental assessment is not necessary because the proposed new incinerator is in an adjacent district and therefore a change is required. The judge instructed them to clarify the basis for their judgment, and they will submit supporting documents next time. After the event, a report session was held at Karesansui in Shimizu Town from 6:30 pm. Two local newspaper reporters, the plaintiffs, and other supporters of Shimizu Town participated, and the session lasted just over two hours.
